name: Dulhansdiary
title: An online store for Pakistani bridal jewellery, bags and wedding accessories
summary: Dulhansdiary sells handmade Pakistani bridal jewellery, clutches, potli bags, juttis and keepsake boxes to international customers. I built its PHP store with Stripe and PayPal checkout.

metrics.label: shipping regions: UK, US, Canada, Australia, UAE, Kuwait

problem: A bridal accessories brand needed to sell a large, many-category catalogue to customers outside Pakistan with secure card and PayPal payments.

constraints.label: International buyers
constraints.text: Customers shop from several countries, so the store has to handle several currencies.

constraints.label: Large catalogue
constraints.text: Jewellery, bags, footwear and gift boxes each need their own collections.

architecture.caption: Browse a collection, open a product, add it to the cart and pay with Stripe or PayPal.

sections.heading: What the store offers
paras: Collections for bridal sets, bangles, earrings, tikka, potli and beaded bags, clutches, bridal and kids' footwear and keepsake boxes, plus new-in and clearance sections, a size guide, a blog and shipping, refund and policy pages.

outcome: I delivered a working store with Stripe and PayPal checkout. The live site has since moved to Shopify.
